exposure: polymerase chain reaction - group B streptococci test (PCR-GBS test)
risk factors for EOGBS (Bacteriuria during current pregnancy, Prior infant with EOGBS, Temperature above 38.0 degC during labor, Rupture of membranes >=18 h)
outcome: antibiotic prophylaxis in term laboring women (decision/usage)
cohort: The study enrolled 902 unselected Danish term pregnant women.
finding: The PCR-GBS test showed good performance (sensitivity 83%, specificity 97%) for identifying GBS colonization in term laboring women, and its use, especially when combined with risk factors for EOGBS, could potentially reduce penicillin usage by two-thirds from 12% to 4%.
